landing.kicker: Weddings, tois and anniversaries in Kyrgyzstan
landing.title: Plan your celebration without endless calls or blind prepayments
landing.subtitle: Browse halls, motorcades, hosts and photographers in one feed, book available dates and pay through a safe deal.
landing.howTitle: Three steps from an idea to a booked date
landing.how1: Tell the assistant about your event
landing.how1Text: Date, city, guests and budget — the assistant builds a checklist and finds available vendors.
landing.how2Text: Real work from vendors, like a social feed: save what you like, follow, message directly.
landing.how3Text: The prepayment is frozen and goes to the vendor only after you both confirm the deal.
landing.dealTitle: Money moves only when you've agreed
landing.dealText: Like P2P: the prepayment stays on the EVENTUS account while the client and vendor agree the details in the chat. Both press “Confirm” — only then the vendor gets paid. If something goes wrong, the money is refunded or our team resolves the dispute.
landing.invTitle: An invitation as a beautiful page, not a picture in a messenger
landing.invText: Build a page from blocks: cover, schedule, countdown, map, dress code. Send each guest a personal link and see who opened it and who's coming.
landing.inv1: Editor with themes, fonts and undo
landing.inv2: Personal links greeting guests by name
landing.venTitle: Clients, calendar and money in one dashboard
landing.ven1Text: Post your work — clients find you through photos and follow you.
landing.ven2Text: Mark offline orders so nobody books you on a taken date.
landing.ven3Text: The client prepays before the deal — once confirmed, the money is yours.
faq: How much does EVENTUS cost for clients?
Nothing. The service is free for clients: you only pay vendors their prices.
What if a vendor doesn't show up?
The prepayment is frozen until the deal is confirmed. Open a dispute in the chat — the EVENTUS team reviews it and refunds you.
After payment a deal card appears in the chat. Once everything is agreed, you and the vendor press “Confirm” — the money goes to the vendor.
Yes. Until both sides confirm the deal, the prepayment is refunded in full.
How do I become a vendor?
Press “I'm a vendor” and answer a few questions — your profile, first service and first post go live right away.
landing.finalText: Tell us about your celebration — we'll show who's available on your date.
